answer: The lagoon record keeps the spread, pulse schedules the escalation, and anchor publishes the outcome. A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors since a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 4 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A 394 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
